name: Dexmate Vega 1 Pro
summary: A wheeled humanoid research platform with two 7-DoF arms (5 kg each), a liftable torso reaching 2.2 m and 20 h runtime, sold online with grippers or hands ordered separately.

germany.statusNote: Orderable in Dexmate’s own online store (USD 72,000, end effectors extra, about 4 weeks lead time, freight quoted at checkout); Germany is in the store’s shipping-country list and Universität Freiburg is shown as a client. Import duties, VAT and CE marking are not stated.

priceOther.market: Dexmate online store (US), without end effectors

sellers.name: Dexmate Inc.
sellers.note: Manufacturer online store in USD; robots are crated and shipped by freight. Quotes and invoices via the contact page.

specs.label: Degrees of freedom
specs.conditions: arms 14, torso 3, head 3, base 4; without hands

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: stereo RGB camera on 3-DoF head, front and rear LiDAR, 4 RGB cameras on base

specs.label: Software
specs.value: Python, C++ and Rust APIs; URDF/USD sim models; VR and exoskeleton teleoperation

notes: End effectors are ordered separately: Dexmate 6-DoF hand, DexGripper S (USD 3,000) or D (USD 4,000), or your own tool.
Position-controlled arms; force/torque sensing is an optional add-on.
Omnidirectional wheeled base for indoor floors; folds down to pass through doorways.
Sold as a developer and research platform; it does not come with ready-made work skills.
The store also lists a cheaper Vega 1 U (USD 40,000); not covered by this record.
